means.example-sentence: I believe we should all try to be considerate of others’ happiness and comfort.
means.sentence-jp: 私たちは皆、他人の幸福と安心を思いやる努力をするべきだと思う。

cloze.maskedText: I believe we should all try to be ____ others’ happiness and comfort.
cloze.answerBase: be considerate of ~ / be considerate to ~

notes: It is considerate of ~ to do. は『…するとは〜は思いやりがある』。
